name: Palti
title: Mikal's second husband
summary: Palti (also called Paltiel) was the son of Laish from Gallim. He was given Mikal, Saul's daughter and David's first wife, as a spouse by King Saul while David was on the run. When David later demanded Mikal back, Palti was forced to give her up and followed weeping after her to Bahurim.

keyEvents.title: Saul gives Mikal to Palti
keyEvents.description: After David fled from Saul, King Saul gave his daughter Mikal, who was David's wife, to Palti, the son of Laish from Gallim.

keyEvents.title: David demands Mikal back
keyEvents.description: When David negotiated with Ish-Bosheth to become king over all Israel, he demanded that Mikal, Saul's daughter, be brought back to him as a condition of the agreement.

keyEvents.title: Palti follows weeping after Mikal
keyEvents.description: When Ish-Bosheth sent messengers and took Mikal from Palti (Paltiel), her husband followed weeping after her all the way to Bahurim, before Abner sent him away.

keyEvents.title: Abner Sends Palti Home
keyEvents.description: Abner, Saul's commander, ordered Palti to turn back and go home, and Palti obeyed and left Michal forever.
